Checkpoint disposition 2026-09-13: remain OPEN at P3 and DEFERRED, now explicitly provisional pending PHRF-33. PHRF-07's backend timings did not execute the shared decoder or final readout certification, so they do not settle the full B0 decision.

Do not start finite-state implementation solely because this issue is open or appears ready. PHRF-33 must measure the unchanged complete workload and record a pass or a concrete activation decision. A passing complete checkpoint keeps this deferred. If TrialBanded misses the frozen engineering budget, PHRF-33 records the trigger, scope and release dependency changes that make PHRF-10 (and its required PHRF-30 realization) active. No universal finite-state gate is introduced without that evidence.

---
Prior implementation criteria retained for traceability (the dated scope clarification above governs where it differs):

Opened only by the PHRF-07 dense-overlap checkpoint. Scope as revision 1.
